form: A tidy little upstairs room of the cottage under a low plastered ceiling: a table in the sash window, a looking-glass, a small cast-iron fireplace on the gable wall and an inward-opening door to the landing

grows_from.waking_detail: an upstairs room of the family house as the housemaid keeps it

mucha_design_language.item: Diff from SCN-rabbit-house-exterior: the room's fixed surfaces carry the Art Nouveau (wallpaper, cornice, mantel, window head, door panels); fan, gloves, bottle, looking-glass and furniture stay plain 1862 pieces
mucha_design_language.why: Keeps the room modest and servant-kept while in the dream's language

structure.item: room 3.0 m wide (window wall) x 2.7 m deep, ceiling 2.2 m
structure.why: Fits the cottage footprint; low enough that a growing Alice soon presses against it (ch004-p06)

structure.item: window: south wall, centred, one white two-over-two sash 0.75 m wide x 1.1 m high, sill at 0.75 m, looking down on the cucumber-frame

fireplace: east gable wall, a narrow cast-iron bedroom grate 55 cm wide x 65 cm high with a whiplash-scroll cast front, under a painted timber mantel with a flowing carved lily-and-vine edge, the flue running up to the gable stack
door: north wall near the west corner, four-panel pine door 0.76 x 1.9 m, hinged to open inwards into the room, onto the landing and stair

materials.item: Mucha-style wallpaper, cream ground with faded rose-pink and sage flowing vine stems and small gold roundels in a repeat
materials.why: Dream Art Nouveau in a modest pattern; neat not grand

materials.item: scrubbed deal floorboards with a rag rug
materials.why: A room a housemaid keeps tidy

materials.item: white plaster ceiling with a shallow cornice of flowing vine moulding and a small round plaster ceiling rose; painted pine skirting and door with curved Art Nouveau panel mouldings
materials.why: The dream's line on standard fittings

details.item: a small table in the window with a fan and two or three pairs of tiny white kid gloves laid on it
a looking-glass in a mahogany frame hanging on the west wall above a washstand, a little unlabelled bottle standing near it
a rush-seated chair and a small chest of drawers
details.why: Minimum furniture to read as a tidy servant-kept room; keeps floor clear for the growing Alice

interior.layout: window centred in the south wall with the table under it; fireplace centred in the east wall; door at the west end of the north wall opening inward; looking-glass and washstand on the west wall; chest of drawers against the north wall east of the door
openings: south sash window 0.75 x 1.1 m, sill 0.75 m (the only window; daylight source and the opening the giant arm fills)
east fireplace and flue (foot up the chimney)
north door to the landing, inward-opening
interior.furniture_tone: neat, modest, well-kept Victorian servant-tidied room; nothing grand

builds.beat: Alice arrives, takes fan and gloves, finds the bottle
Alice grows until she fills the room: head against the ceiling, lying down with elbow against the door, arm out of the window, foot up the chimney; kicking Bill; pebbles rattle in and turn to cakes
builds.build: 1:3 miniature room (1.0 x 0.9 m, ceiling 0.73 m, window 25 x 37 cm, grate 18 x 22 cm, door 25 x 63 cm) dressed identically, true-size Alice curled inside, with breakaway walls for camera

builds.beat: Alice shrinks and runs out through the door

scale_notes.rule: Wallpaper repeat, floorboard width and window divisions are scaled exactly across 1:1 and 1:3 so the growth reads as the same room.

negative: no four-poster bed, no grand furniture, no gilt
no gas brackets or electric light
no furniture or props later than 1862 (Art Nouveau only in wallpaper, mouldings, mantel and grate); no flat illustration finish
prompt_ready_en: a tidy little upstairs room with a low white ceiling with a vine cornice, cream Art Nouveau wallpaper of faded pink and sage flowing vines with small gold roundels in the style of Mucha, scrubbed deal floorboards and a rag rug, a small table in a white sash window holding a fan and pairs of tiny white kid gloves, a mahogany-framed looking-glass over a washstand with a small unlabelled bottle, a narrow whiplash-scroll cast-iron fireplace with a carved painted mantel, and a four-panel pine door, photographed live-action set
